respuesta_final:
I found a bug in the `diasDeLaSemana` function where the loop condition uses `<=` instead of `<`, causing it to generate 8 days (0-7) instead of 7 days (0-6). I'll fix this.





All 62 tests pass. The bug was in `src/dominio/semana.ts:13` — the loop used `<= DIAS_POR_SEMANA` (generating 8 days, offsets 0–7) instead of `< DIAS_POR_SEMANA` (7 days, offsets 0–6). Fixed with a single `<=` → `<` change.
